visual.general_description: Grayscale sector-shaped cross-sectional image with a central heterogeneous region and measurement markers.
visual.detailed_description: Fan-shaped (sector) grayscale image on a black background with a short alphanumeric text label at the upper left edge. The upper part shows bright and dark horizontal layered bands. Right of centre is a dark, nearly homogeneous elongated region. Below it lies a heterogeneous region of mixed gray and brighter echoes with an even brighter patch toward the lower right. Within the central region, dotted lines with plus-sign markers cross each other: one runs from the upper centre down toward the lower centre, another runs across from the left toward the right; a further plus marker sits right of centre. No printed measurement values, scale bar, axis or panel letter are visible.
